data.title: Animals With Wings and Without Wings
data.instructions: Drag each animal to the correct group based on whether it has wings.

categories.label: Has Wings
categories.description: Animals that have wings on their bodies

categories.label: No Wings
categories.description: Animals that do not have wings

items.label: Robin
items.hint: Look closely at its sides. Can it fly using feathers?
items.distractorReasoning: Clear example of an animal with wings

items.label: Dog
items.hint: Dogs run on four legs and have fur, but do they have wings?
items.distractorReasoning: Clear example of an animal without wings

items.label: Butterfly
items.hint: Look at the pretty patterns on its sides that help it fly!

items.label: Cat
items.hint: Cats are furry pets, but do they have wings to fly?

items.label: Penguin
items.hint: Even though it is a bird that cannot fly in the air, does it still have wings on its body?
items.distractorReasoning: Boundary case: Students often think because it cannot fly, it has no wings

items.label: Bat
items.hint: Even though it flies in the night sky like a bird, look at its skin wings and furry body.
items.distractorReasoning: Boundary case: Mammal that flies, often confused with birds

items.label: Frog
items.hint: Frogs jump and swim, but do they have wings?

items.label: Spider
items.hint: Spiders have many legs and make webs, but do they have wings?
items.distractorReasoning: Often grouped with flying bugs because it is a small creepy-crawly

data.sortingRule: Sort by whether the animal has wings or does not have wings
